# imperious

> having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy.

> Commanding, domineering; acting like a high-ranking person; urgent

> having an arrogant or domineering manner


## Example

- *Children are imperious with each other before they learn that earning someone's respect is better than demanding.*
